music_prompt: Cinematic emotional score for a {dur} second film. Opens with soft solo felt piano, lonely late night mood, slow, about 70 bpm, lots of space. Around the middle, warm strings and a gentle heartbeat pulse enter as hope arrives. Final third is warm, uplifting and resolved, with a soft swell in the last five seconds that lands and rings out. No vocals, no drums, no EDM, no risers.
